key_values.event_name: March-April 2024 West Africa and Sahel humid heat wave

decision_rule.formula_hottest_3day_mean: max rolling 3-day mean of daily Tmax
decision_rule.classification_rule: persistent label requires all days Tmax>=40C, all nights Tmin>=27C, and hdd40>10C-days

criteria.name: Required JSON diagnosis
criteria.description: Returns exactly the requested compact JSON fields: event_days, hot_day_count_tmax_ge_40c, hdd40_c_days, hottest_3day_mean_tmax_c, warm_night_count_tmin_ge_27c, apparent_peak_lead_days, and classification.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the answer has the right intent but omits one or two fields, uses unclear field names, or adds distracting narrative fields.

criteria.name: Day-night persistence counts
criteria.description: Computes the 5-day window, all five daily Tmax values at or above 40 C, and all five nightly Tmin values at or above 27 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct hot-day or warm-night counts with one missing count or minor threshold wording error; award 1 point for naming the event window only.

criteria.name: Heat-load arithmetic
criteria.description: Applies sum(max(Tmax - 40, 0)) across the event window and reports 15.1 C-days within 0.1 C-days.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct formula with a small arithmetic or rounding error; award 1 point for using only peak temperature.

criteria.name: Peak three-day window
criteria.description: Computes rolling three-day Tmax means and reports the hottest mean as 43.6 C within 0.1 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct rolling-window method with a small numeric error or for reporting the right peak days without the mean.

criteria.name: Apparent-temperature timing
criteria.description: Identifies the daily apparent-temperature peak on 2024-04-02 and the dry-bulb Tmax peak on 2024-04-03, giving a 1-day lead.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming one of the two peak dates or noting that apparent-temperature timing differs from dry-bulb timing.

criteria.name: Classification rule
criteria.description: Applies the stated rule and returns persistent_day_night_heat_load because all three threshold checks pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a broadly correct persistent heat-load label without showing all required threshold checks.

criteria.name: Computed scope
criteria.description: Keeps the answer limited to computed heat-load evidence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0 points if the answer shifts into a broad event essay or adds unneeded planning guidance.
